race.comment: SHINELIKETHESUN (8) finished second when resuming last start despite copping a check and galloping, beaten 6 metres over 2100m at Geelong. Shouldn't spend a penny from this draw and the sprint lane may come in handy. Won't find this any harder and she can take this out. MINNIE MIA (4) is better than her last-start run when finishing seventh over 1609m at Geelong would suggest. Worth another chance.. THE TROUT COD (2) broke through last time out over 2240m at Melton. Must be included with the confidence up. Something for the Multiples: WIND STORM (5)
